body:
Per the Appendix E note and the Frontispiece guidance to log a ticket when a credit is missing from the 5.x list, I would like to request addition to the Appendix E contributors list.

Qualifying contribution: I commented on issue #3335, contributing a context change taxonomy and behavioral definitions distinguishing encoding, neutralization, and sanitization. These were endorsed by project lead Jim Manico.

- https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/3335#issuecomment-4054988412
- https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/3335#issuecomment-4058078896

Appendix E acknowledges those who have commented or opened pull requests since ASVS 4.0.0, which this contribution meets.

Requested entry, matching the existing format: Jeromme (Jeremy) Lawler ([J-XL](https://github.com/J-XL))

comments.body: Note that we usually collect the contributors' list before a new release. Those comments are made after the last release, and therefore, at the moment, the credit is not "missing".

title: Requesting Appendix E credit: J-XL (commented on #3335, endorsed by project lead)
